title: VB4-style War GUI on green felt

credits.credit: Source-based vector graphics authored for this production; no third-party images or font files included.

tests.result: Run tools/validate_delivery.py after manifest creation; result is stored in review/delivery-validation.json.
Hash-locked originals retained; validate_pack.py output recorded in review/pack-validation.txt.

result.mode: Standalone 1920 × 1080 poster inspection plus overview sheet
result.scope: Reviewed the full-resolution still and its appearance in the overview.
result.status: Type, negative space, card legibility, and annotations inspected. CODE-02 pointer, code soft wrapping, small-card details, and saved-top labeling were corrected during this pass. Not all temporal frames received independent manual review.

tests.test: offline HTML, deterministic seek, every SVG text bounding box

tests.result: 8 inlined 1.0.0 faces in 4 src SVGs (165 px (157 px backs unchanged)) replaced by the 1.1.0 studio.card() output at identical parameters (each recovered parameter set re-emitted the 1.0.0 group byte for byte); index.html scene table rebuilt; python tools/render/render_assets.py --id MOCK-01 re-rendered every export; the offline browser check was re-run (evidence/browser-tests.json).

result.mode: Poster at 1920 × 1080 and 1280 wide, plus one extracted frame of each MP4 at both sizes, viewed by the worker.
result.scope: Card faces only; timing, layout and text were not re-reviewed beyond confirming they are unchanged.
result.status: A♠ and K♥ at 165 px on the felt in poster.png, concept.png and annotated.png: the ace with one large pip, the king with crown, K letter and one heart pip, both with the rank-over-suit index in both corners; the 157 px backs, the 25 / 25 / pot 2 counts, the Win95 chrome and the annotations are unchanged.
